authority: Selected READY implementation item under the active discovery-and-conformance frontier and the owner request to complete exactly one work item.
implementation_scope: Repair the shared closure controller with exclusive repository ownership, immutable stage receipts, exact dependency-aware resume/invalidation, isolated control outputs, and privacy-preserving aggregate model-usage extraction. Reproduce the known concurrency and receipt-discovery failure classes in focused fixtures, then complete one ordered real closure.
repair_policy: REPAIR_AND_CONTINUE; preserve every failed controller attempt and immutable stage receipt. Unknown or malformed invalidation evidence fails closed. No scientific experiment or historical memory audit is authorized.
usage_policy: Record aggregate response-level numeric usage by unique response identity. Keep cached input, derived uncached input, cache-write input, output and reasoning output separate; record missing coverage and no monetary estimate; never retain private conversation contents.
external_actions: Only the repository's authorized main delivery is permitted.
scope_amendment: The closure scope adds the concrete E0 successor plan and the required preserved implementation-failure record. Both are direct completion/handoff requirements of the bound reliability plan; no scientific launch or unrelated implementation scope was added.
